scope: Thirty-seven statements: the time-reversal chain rule, sign reversal of a given viscous rate and complete scalar RHS, exponential damping/amplification for an assumed Laplacian eigenmode, Euler-increment sign identities, and their form in the mentor and student model: reversal around the 0,0 split, shares, gap/touch/overlap, the tick 23 freeze, the wall viscosity 1/50 + (1/25)(gAB + gBA), and what the wall takes forward and gives backward on one ripple counted from the split.
